stem.text: The graphs show various distance measurements taken from the start of metaphase of mitosis. The graphs are to scale when compared to one another.

stem.label: X
stem.alt: Graph labelled X with a vertical axis labelled distance and a horizontal axis labelled time. The curve is level and then decreases.

stem.label: Y
stem.alt: Graph labelled Y with a vertical axis labelled distance and a horizontal axis labelled time. The curve is flat at zero and then rises before levelling off.

stem.text: Which row correctly identifies the distance measurement for each graph?

A.text: distance between poles of spindle; distance of centromeres from poles of spindle

B.text: distance between poles of spindle; distance between sister chromatids

C.text: distance of centromeres from poles of spindle; distance between sister chromatids

D.text: distance of centromeres from poles of spindle; distance between poles of spindle

A:
distance of centromeres
from poles of spindle
C:
distance of centromeres
from poles of spindle
D:
distance of centromeres
from poles of spindle
